verses.ya-aliman-lana-l-jamila-azhara-c1-v1: yā ʿālimā lanā l-jamīla ʾaẓharā waghāfirā lanā l-qabīḥa satarā
verses.ya-aliman-lana-l-jamila-azhara-c1-v3: wayā ʿaẓīma l-ʿafwi lil-ʾathīmi yā ḥasana t-tajāwuzi l-ʿamīmi
verses.ya-aliman-lana-l-jamila-azhara-c1-v5: yā sāmiʿa bikulli najwā muntahā bikulli shakwā walahu mā yushtahā
verses.ya-aliman-lana-l-jamila-azhara-c1-v6: wayā karīma ṣ-ṣafḥi yā ḥalīmā wayā ʿaẓīma l-manni yā raḥīmā
verses.ya-aliman-lana-l-jamila-azhara-c1-v7: wayā muqīla l-ʿatharāti hafawāt mubtadiʾia biniʿami wamin hibāt
verses.ya-aliman-lana-l-jamila-azhara-c1-v8: bil-faḍli wal-ʾiḥsāni rabbī faʿalā min qablu bīstiḥqāqihā jalla ʿalā
verses.ya-aliman-lana-l-jamila-azhara-c1-v9: yā rabbi sayyidī wayā mawlāyā ghāyata raghbatī ʾaṭib maḥyāyā
verses.ya-aliman-lana-l-jamila-azhara-c1-v10: ʾasʾaluka llāhumma yā raḥmānu fala tushawwih khilqatī mannānu
verses.ya-aliman-lana-l-jamila-azhara-c1-v2: walam yuʾākhidhān lanā l-jarīrat lam yahtiki s-sitra walī s-sarīʾa
verses.ya-aliman-lana-l-jamila-azhara-c1-v4: yā wāsiʿa l-maghfirati l-ʿamīmat yā bāsiṭa l-yadayni yā dhā r-raḥma
verses.ya-aliman-lana-l-jamila-azhara-c1-v11: ʿalā balā d-dunyā ʿadhābi n-nāri fahb lanā najāta tilka d-dāri
